# rrealpath

> Executive coaching by René Anant Feddersen for senior executives and leaders navigating a diverse and fast-changing global business environment. The coaching establishes the big picture and builds the long view. Based in Chiang Mai, Thailand; working across Southeast Asia and the world.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://rrealpath.com/): who René coaches and the focus of the coaching — the big picture and the long view
- [Insights](https://rrealpath.com/insights): rrealpath articles — mainstream narratives explored, hidden assumptions questioned; leadership, decision-making, coaching, culture and the monthly AI Insights issue
- [Coach](https://rrealpath.com/coach): the coaching process (the Big Picture and the Long View), René's resume, a client testimonial and background
- [Connect](https://rrealpath.com/connect): write to René — for executives and entrepreneurs, and for HR, people and L&D placing a coach. Contact: coach@rrealpath.com
